name: Dog rabies with mass vaccination and dog-to-human transmission
description:
Rabies, domestic dogs → humans, urban African setting (N'Djaména, Chad).
Transmission is density-dependent with an explicit area term — beta_d has units km²·dog⁻¹·week⁻¹, so the per-capita hazard is beta_d Id / area.
Parameter values: 0 of 15 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Zinsstag J, Dürr S, Penny MA, Mindekem R, Roth F, Menendez Gonzalez S, Naissengar S, Hattendorf J (2009). Transmission dynamics and economics of rabies control in dogs and humans in an African city. PNAS 106(35):14996–15001

compartments.name: Dd
compartments.description: cumulative rabid-dog deaths (for fitting to weekly rabid-dog reports)

parameters.name: beta_d
parameters.description: dog-to-dog transmission rate [verified] (estimated by the authors) (km² per dog per week)

parameters.name: beta_dh
parameters.description: dog-to-human transmission rate [verified] (km² per dog per week)

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: area of the study city, converting counts to densities [illustrative] (km²)

parameters.name: sigma_d
parameters.description: rate of leaving dog incubation (≈22 d mean incubation) [illustrative] (per week)

parameters.name: mu_d
parameters.description: rabies-induced death rate of rabid dogs (≈4 d survival); the sensitivity analysis identifies this as one of the three most influential parameters [verified as i

parameters.name: rd
parameters.description: probability that an exposed dog develops clinical rabies; also identified as highly influential [verified as influential; value illustrative] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: wane_d
parameters.description: waning of dog vaccine immunity + turnover of vaccinated dogs [illustrative] (per week)

parameters.name: cull_d
parameters.description: dog culling rate (alternative control the authors simulate) [illustrative] (per week)

parameters.name: rh
parameters.description: probability a bitten human develops rabies absent prophylaxis [illustrative] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: pep
parameters.description: proportion of exposed humans receiving effective post-exposure prophylaxis [illustrative] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: sigma_h
parameters.description: rate of leaving human incubation (≈6 weeks) [illustrative] (per week)

parameters.name: mu_h
parameters.description: death rate of clinical human rabies (uniformly fatal within days) [illustrative] (per week)

variables.name: lambda_d
variables.description: dog force of infection (density-dependent: the transmission rate is per unit area)

variables.name: Re
variables.description: effective reproduction ratio; the authors estimate Re ≈ 1.01 at the onset of observation, consistent with stable endemic dynamics [verified]

variables.name: cover
variables.description: vaccination coverage; a single campaign reaching ≥70% coverage was reported sufficient to interrupt transmission to humans for at least 6 ye
